node_record: cooling curvature (K m^-2 in the quadratic geotherm)
feg_format_contract.pre_orbdata_getnet: Reads only node ID, longitude, latitude, elevation and heat flow; converts degrees to radians internally. It deliberately skips the final four nodal quantities.
feg_format_contract.putnet: Writes the expanded nine-value node record, coordinates in degrees, triangular elements, and optional fault elements; LR integer tags are optional.
feg_format_contract.continuum_element: element ID, three node IDs counterclockwise, optional LR integer tag
feg_format_contract.fault_element: fault ID, n1 n2 n3 n4, dip1 dip2 in degrees from horizontal, nonnegative past offset, optional LR integer tag
feg_format_contract.numbering: Fake-node numbering is explicitly outdated/unsupported. GetNet maps external IDs above nRealN through n1000 to internal contiguous IDs; PutNet reverses it. ARCANA duplication uses ordinary valid numerical nodes.
feg_format_contract.units_basis: Field units follow source SI variable names, constants and calculations, including oneKm and density_anomaly_kgpm3. The writer has no complete adjacent units legend; future writer must make units explicit.

fault_and_junction_contract.fault_order: n1,n2 left-to-right on near side; n3 opposite n2; n4 opposite n1. Physical endpoint A is n1<->n4; B is n2<->n3. Payload also stores two dips, past offset, optional LR.
fault_and_junction_contract.identity: One canonical physical point may map to multiple coincident ordinary FEG node IDs with canonical point ID, side/domain, incident branches, fault IDs and continuum domains retained.
fault_and_junction_contract.square: Pairs opposite-side fault endpoint nodes, gathers connected nearby corner nodes at the intersection and averages positions if needed. ARCANA must emit exactly coincident coordinates; averaging is tolerance handling, not geometry repair.
fault_and_junction_contract.next: Matches continuum sides to four-node fault ordering, crosses faults to locate adjacent triangles, returning kFault and kEle; test side adjacency and no accidental exterior edge.
fault_and_junction_contract.maxAtP_scope: OrbData5-specific overlap-node capacity; check each compiled component's actual bound.
fault_and_junction_contract.junction_expansion_rule: For the selected fault set, remove discontinuity edges from local continuum connectivity, find mechanically independent incident continuum sectors, and allocate one coincident FEG node per sector/side incidence with provenance. Do not hard-code copies to degree three or invent junction mechanics.
fault_and_junction_contract.exact_arcana_multiplicity: Unbound because no canonical boundary is selected as a mechanical fault. At nFl=0 Level 1, one continuum node identity per canonical physical junction suffices; fault expansion is deferred.

global_and_qualification.global_sphere: After Square, SHELLS sets sphere=.TRUE. when nCond==0; Square returns without perimeter tracing. SHELLS calls Downer, which can add constraints for specific truncated thrust/slab-footwall geometry.
global_and_qualification.external_perimeter: No ordinary exterior perimeter for a closed global sphere; do not emit ordinary perimeter .bcs entries. With nFl=0 no fault footwalls exist.
global_and_qualification.level1: A bounded global continuum integration qualification fixture is feasible in principle with closed sphere, nFl=0 and no topology-derived interior VBCs, if it retains fields required by that limited objective. This is not a production/fault mechanics qualification and no runtime was run here.
global_and_qualification.level2: Later use synthetic fixture faults or a governed mechanical subset; never map all 1,983 kinematic boundary segments to fault elements by default.
global_and_qualification.interior_vbc: README labels Earth5R-type4A as no plate-interior VBCs. plusA adds type-5 internal constraints; Tract describes prior torque runs commonly using trHMax=0 and extra VBCs on slabless plates to infer basal tractions. This Earth torque/basal-traction iteration is not an ARCANA minimum.
global_and_qualification.minimum_constrained_dofs: ReadBC's >=3 guard applies only NOT sphere and trHMax<=0; the global sphere bypasses it. This guard sets no positive global minimum, but does not prove global solver uniqueness/nullspace removal.

frame_and_gauge.future_transform: If used, subtract/add a rigid numerical reference rotation invertibly and test relative plate velocities, boundary-relative motion and strain invariance. Reference is NUMERICAL_GAUGE_REFERENCE, never PHYSICALLY_FIXED_CANONICAL_PLATE.
